subject: Additional review of PR #20 — Phase 6 CodeRabbit comment fixes
summary: PR #20 addresses CodeRabbit review comments from PR #18/#19 but introduces two new issues: (1) m_active declared as non-mutable std::atomic<bool> in a const-safeHonor() method — store() is non-const, causing compilation failure; (2) m_mode write occurs AFTER the release store on m_active, so the release/acquire pair does not establish happens-before for m_mode reads in getStatus() — data race. Fixes applied: mutable std::atomic<bool> m_active; reordered writes (m_mode before release-store); getStatus() now acquire-loads m_active.
next_action: Create PR from phase-6-hermes-review-fixes against phase-6-review-fixes (or main if PR #20 merges first)
